subject: ClearWave CAIQ intake — scheduling, recording permission, and evidence checklist
messages:
From: Alice Morrison <alice.morrison@clearwave.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: security@clearwave.com
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 13:15:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ intake — can we schedule a quick sync + initial artifact ask

Hi Irene —

Thanks for the quick intro last week. ClearWave is running through CAIQ answers internally and we'd like to schedule a 45-minute intake call to align on the scope, owners, and sample artifacts.

Two quick asks for the call:
- Can Redwood confirm whether recording the call is OK for our audit notes?
- Do you have a short checklist of the most common artifacts (logs, KMS config, infra diagrams) so we can pre-stage access before the call?

We have availability: Wed 5/13 09:30–11:30 PT or Thu 5/14 14:00–16:00 PT.

Attached is a one-page request template we use for intake.

Best,
Alice Morrison
Security Program Manager
ClearWave Therapeutics
[Attachment: ClearWave_Request_Template.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood-inference.com>
To: Alice Morrison <alice.morrison@clearwave.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ intake — can we schedule a quick sync + initial artifact ask

Hi Alice — thanks for reaching out and for the template. Recording is fine with us (we usually record CAIQ walkthroughs for our audit notes).

Proposed slot: Wed 5/13 10:00–10:45 PT — does that work? If not, Thu 5/14 14:30 PT is our fallback.

I've attached a short CAIQ prefill worksheet (preliminary answers and gaps) and a short artifact checklist below so you can pull the most common items ahead of time. Marissa and Ben are on copy — they will be the evidence owners for logging & network configs respectively.

Common artifact checklist (we find these save the most time):
- Sample infrastructure diagram (zoomed to account/project level)
- KMS configuration summary / key rotation policy (redacted if necessary)
- Recent control-plane audit/log samples (7–30 day window)
- Tokenization/encryption at rest notes and sample table schemata if applicable
- Access control matrix or group-to-role mapping for admin console
- Any existing SOC 2 report or third-party assessment (helps us scope additional asks)

We'll also request a small set of log pulls for ingestion profiling during the call — Marissa will follow up with a named list of exact log paths.

Attachments: Redwood_CAICQ_Prelim-answers_v1.xlsx

Irene Choi
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood-inference.com
[Attachment: Redwood_CAICQ_Prelim-answers_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

Marissa, can you take file-level access & KMS samples? I will prepare a sanitized log export (names redacted) and a short README of the logging retention windows.

Will post the artifacts to the shared intake folder once ready.

- Ben

From: Alice Morrison <alice.morrison@clearwave.com>

Subject: Re: CAIQ intake — can we schedule a quick sync + initial artifact ask

Irene — Wed 5/13 10:00 PT works for us. Recording consent confirmed — thanks.

A couple of clarifying questions ahead of the call so we can prepare:
1) Log retention: what are the default retention windows Redwood keeps for API request logs vs. platform audit logs? If you can paste the retention durations during the call that would be ideal.
2) SOC 2 scope: does Redwood maintain an internal SOC 2 report that covers hosted API and dedicated deployments? If so, is there a redacted copy you can share under NDA?

We will upload the one-page request template to the shared folder and add contact info for our technical lead (Samir Patel) who may join the intake call.

Thanks — see you at 10:00 PT.

— Alice
